title: Initialize monorepo: folder structure, configs, symlinks
description: Create the monorepo folder structure, configuration files, and symlinks so that all agents share the same AGENTS.md context.
acceptance_criteria: All directories from AGENTS.md section 5 exist
biome.json is configured at root
.gitignore exists with node_modules, dist, .env entries
Symlinks: CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, .github/copilot-instructions.md point to AGENTS.md
harness/workflows/runs/.gitkeep exists
done_when: ls shows all directories match AGENTS.md section 5

title: Campaign CRUD API
description: REST endpoints to create, read, update, and soft-delete campaigns.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/campaigns creates a campaign and returns 201
GET /api/campaigns returns paginated list of campaigns
GET /api/campaigns/:id returns single campaign with content pieces
PATCH /api/campaigns/:id updates campaign fields
DELETE /api/campaigns/:id soft-deletes a campaign
All endpoints return proper HTTP status codes on error (400, 404)
Input validation rejects malformed payloads with 400
Database migration creates campaigns table with: id, name, description, status, createdAt, updatedAt
test_requirements: Unit test for campaign service: create, findAll, findOne, update, remove
Integration test for each endpoint (REQUEST → RESPONSE validation)
Test validation pipe rejects empty name and unknown fields
done_when: All tests pass (≥80% coverage on module)
Security reviewer has confirmed no secrets exposed
API can be tested manually via curl or Swagger

title: Content Piece CRUD API
description: REST endpoints to create, read, update, and delete content pieces within a campaign.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/campaigns/:id/content creates a content piece and returns 201
GET /api/campaigns/:id/content returns list of content pieces
GET /api/content/:id returns single content piece
PATCH /api/content/:id updates content fields
DELETE /api/content/:id soft-deletes content
Content belongs to a campaign (foreign key constraint)
Content has fields: headline, description, body, language, state
Content state defaults to 'draft'
test_requirements: Unit test for content service: create, findAll, findOne, update, remove
Integration test for each endpoint
Test that content cannot be created for non-existent campaign (404)

title: PostgreSQL schema & migrations
description: Create the database schema, enums, indices, and migration files using Prisma/TypeORM/Alembic.
acceptance_criteria: Campaigns table with: id (UUID), name, description, status, createdAt, updatedAt, isDeleted
Content pieces table with: id (UUID), campaignId (FK), headline, description, body, language, state (enum), createdAt, updatedAt, isDeleted
Review state enum: draft, suggested_by_ai, reviewed, approved, rejected
Indices on: campaignId, state, isDeleted
Migration is reversible (up/down or rollback supported)
test_requirements: Migration script runs without errors
Rollback restores previous schema state
done_when: Migration applies cleanly on fresh PostgreSQL

title: AI provider abstraction layer (OpenAI + Anthropic)
description: Build an abstract AI service that supports both OpenAI and Anthropic providers with fallback logic.
acceptance_criteria: AiService interface/abstraction with generateDraft() and translate() methods
OpenAI provider implements the interface using OpenAI SDK
Anthropic provider implements the interface using Anthropic SDK
Provider selection via environment variable (AI_PROVIDER=openai|anthropic)
Automatic fallback if primary provider fails (rate limit, timeout)
Configurable model name, temperature, max tokens
Prompt templates are externalized (not hardcoded in provider logic)
test_requirements: Mock-based test for AiService with OpenAI provider
Mock-based test for AiService with Anthropic provider
Test fallback when primary provider throws
Test that all providers throw when no API key is configured
done_when: All AI unit tests use mocks (no real API calls)

title: AI draft generation endpoint
description: Endpoint that takes a content brief and generates an AI-powered draft (headline + description).
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/content/:id/generate-draft triggers AI generation
Request body contains brief/instructions for the AI
Response returns generated headline and description
Content state transitions from 'draft' to 'suggested_by_ai' on success
Content state transitions back to 'draft' on AI failure
Original content fields are preserved as fallback
test_requirements: Unit test with mocked AI provider returning valid draft
Unit test with mocked AI provider throwing error
Integration test: POST → verify state change
done_when: AI calls are mocked in tests

title: AI translation/localization endpoint
description: Endpoint that translates content into a target language using AI.
acceptance_criteria: POST /api/content/:id/translate triggers AI translation
Request specifies targetLanguage (e.g., es, fr, de)
Response returns translated headline and description
Creates new content piece in target language linked to original (originalId)
New content piece starts in 'suggested_by_ai' state
test_requirements: Unit test with mocked AI provider returning valid translation
Unit test with unsupported language returns 400
Integration test: translate → verify new content piece exists
done_when: AI calls are mocked in tests

title: Review state machine (state transitions, guards)
description: Implement the review state machine with valid transition guards and state enforcement.
acceptance_criteria: Content state enum: draft, suggested_by_ai, reviewed, approved, rejected
Valid transitions are enforced at the service layer
Invalid transitions throw 422 Unprocessable Entity
State history is logged (optional: state_history table)
Only the owner/reviewer can change state (if auth is implemented)
test_requirements: Test all valid transitions succeed
Test all invalid transitions are rejected
Test state persists correctly in database
done_when: Code reviewer and DB reviewer have approved

title: Review endpoints (approve, reject, request edits)
description: Endpoints for human reviewers to approve, reject, or request edits on AI-suggested content.
acceptance_criteria: PATCH /api/content/:id/review with action: 'approve' sets state to 'approved'
PATCH /api/content/:id/review with action: 'reject' sets state to 'rejected'
PATCH /api/content/:id/review with action: 'request_edits' sets state to 'reviewed' and stores feedback
PATCH /api/content/:id/edit updates content body and resets state to 'draft'
Invalid action returns 400
Review feedback is stored (comment field)
test_requirements: Unit test for each review action
Unit test for invalid action returns 400
Integration test: PATCH → verify state change

title: WebSocket/SSE setup in backend
description: Set up WebSocket gateway or SSE endpoint for real-time broadcasting.
acceptance_criteria: WebSocket endpoint or SSE endpoint is available at /ws or /events
Client connects and receives a welcome/connection event
Server can broadcast events to all connected clients
Server can send targeted events to specific clients
Connection lifecycle: connect, disconnect, error handling
test_requirements: Test client can connect and receive events
Test server can broadcast a test event
done_when: Events are received by connected clients

title: Real-time broadcast on state changes
description: Broadcast content state changes to all connected clients in real-time.
acceptance_criteria: When content state changes, an event is broadcast to all WebSocket clients
Event payload includes: contentId, campaignId, oldState, newState, timestamp
Events are triggered by: AI draft generated, review action, edit completed
Events include AI draft preview when applicable
Frontend receives and can display the event
test_requirements: Unit test: state change triggers broadcast
Integration test: PATCH review → verify WebSocket receives event

title: React project scaffold (Vite, routing, API client)
description: Scaffold the React frontend with Vite, React Router, and an API client (axios/fetch).
acceptance_criteria: Vite + React + TypeScript project compiles and runs
React Router configured with routes: /, /campaigns, /campaigns/:id, /content/:id
API client service with base URL from env variable
Error handling interceptor for API responses
TypeScript types for Campaign, Content, ReviewState exist
WebSocket client service exists
test_requirements: App renders without crashing
Router navigates between pages
API client can be instantiated with correct base URL
done_when: pnpm dev starts the dev server
API client makes requests to backend

title: Campaign Dashboard page (list + create)
description: Page that lists all campaigns and allows creating new ones.
acceptance_criteria: GET /api/campaigns data is fetched and displayed as a list
Each campaign shows: name, description, content count, status
Create Campaign button opens a form/modal
Form validates required fields
On submit, POST /api/campaigns is called and list refreshes
Loading state shows skeleton/spinner
Error state shows error message
test_requirements: Component renders campaign list
Create form submission calls API and refreshes list

title: Campaign Detail page (content pieces, states)
description: Detail page for a single campaign showing its content pieces with their review states.
acceptance_criteria: Fetches GET /api/campaigns/:id and displays campaign details
Lists all content pieces with: headline, language, state badge
State badges are color-coded (draft=gray, suggested=blue, reviewed=yellow, approved=green, rejected=red)
Create Content button opens a form
Clicking a content piece navigates to content editor
Add Content form validates required fields
test_requirements: Component renders campaign with content list
State badges render correct colors
done_when: Campaign page loads with all content pieces
State badges are visible and color-coded

title: AI Draft panel (trigger generation, preview)
description: Panel on the content editor that allows triggering AI draft generation and previewing the result.
acceptance_criteria: Generate Draft button is visible when content state is 'draft'
Clicking sends POST /api/content/:id/generate-draft
Loading state shown during generation
AI result displays in a preview panel
User can accept (approve) or reject the AI suggestion
If rejected, user can edit and resubmit
If content is already 'suggested_by_ai', show the AI result
test_requirements: Component renders generate button only for 'draft' state
Clicking generate calls the API

title: Review UI (approve/reject/edit buttons, state badges)
description: UI for human reviewers to approve, reject, or request edits on content.
acceptance_criteria: Approve button visible when state is 'suggested_by_ai' or 'reviewed'
Reject button visible when state is 'suggested_by_ai' or 'reviewed'
Request Edits button opens a feedback textarea
Edit button (when 'rejected') resets content to 'draft' for re-editing
Confirm dialogs for destructive actions
State badge updates immediately after action
test_requirements: Buttons render conditionally based on state
Clicking approve/reject calls the correct API
Edit button works for rejected content
done_when: State badge updates after review action

title: Translation panel (select language, trigger, preview)
description: Panel to trigger AI translation of content into another language.
acceptance_criteria: Translate button visible for approved content
Language selector (dropdown: es, fr, de, pt, it, ja, zh)
Clicking translate sends POST /api/content/:id/translate
Loading state during translation
Translated content preview shows in a panel
User can navigate to the translated content piece
test_requirements: Component renders translate button and language selector
Clicking translate calls the API with correct language
done_when: Translated content piece is created and accessible

title: Real-time status updates on frontend
description: Connect frontend to WebSocket/SSE and display live state changes.
acceptance_criteria: WebSocket client connects on app load
State change events update the UI without page refresh
State badge updates when a real-time event is received
Notification/toast shown when content state changes
Connection status indicator (connected/disconnected)
Auto-reconnect on connection loss
test_requirements: Component renders connection status
Event handler updates state correctly
done_when: State changes appear in real-time without refresh

title: Docker Compose (PostgreSQL + Backend + Frontend)
description: Create compose.yml that runs PostgreSQL, backend, and frontend with one command.
acceptance_criteria: docker compose up starts PostgreSQL, backend, and frontend
Backend waits for PostgreSQL to be healthy (depends_on + healthcheck)
Frontend connects to backend via environment variable
PostgreSQL data persists across restarts (volume mount)
Ports: PostgreSQL 5432, Backend 3000, Frontend 5173
.env.example is used for compose variables
test_requirements: docker compose up --build exits with code 0
docker compose ps shows all services as 'Up'

title: Dockerfiles (backend + frontend multi-stage)
description: Multi-stage Dockerfiles for backend and frontend to minimize image size.
acceptance_criteria: Backend Dockerfile: builder stage with full SDK, production stage with only runtime
Frontend Dockerfile: builder stage with Node, production stage with nginx/static
Images run as non-root user (security)
.dockerignore files exist to exclude node_modules, dist, .env
test_requirements: docker build backend/ succeeds
docker build frontend/ succeeds
done_when: Security reviewer has confirmed non-root user

title: GitHub Actions CI (lint, typecheck, test)
description: CI pipeline that runs on every PR: Biome check, TypeScript typecheck, and tests.
acceptance_criteria: GitHub Actions workflow triggers on push to any branch and PR
Job: Biome check (lint + format)
Job: TypeScript typecheck (tsc --noEmit)
Job: Run unit tests with coverage
Job: Run integration tests with PostgreSQL service container
All jobs must pass before merge
test_requirements: CI can be tested by pushing to a branch
done_when: CI pipeline runs and passes on a test commit

title: End-to-end workflow test (Campaign → Content → AI Draft → Review)
description: Write a full end-to-end integration test that exercises the entire workflow.
acceptance_criteria: Test creates a campaign
Test adds a content piece
Test generates AI draft (mocked)
Test approves the draft
Test triggers translation
Test verifies final state at each step
test_requirements: E2E test file exists in backend/test/e2e/
done_when: All mocks are used (no real AI calls)

title: ADRs (REST vs GraphQL, AI provider, real-time, DB schema)
description: Write the four required Architecture Decision Records.
acceptance_criteria: ADR-001: REST vs GraphQL — decision and reasoning
ADR-002: AI Provider selection — OpenAI vs Anthropic vs both
ADR-003: Real-time mechanism — WebSockets vs SSE vs GraphQL Subscriptions
ADR-004: Database schema — tables, enums, indices design
Each ADR follows the template from AGENTS.md section 10.2
done_when: Each ADR has Context, Decision, Consequences, Alternatives

title: README update (setup instructions, tech decisions, tradeoffs)
description: Update README.md with setup instructions, technology decisions, and tradeoffs made.
acceptance_criteria: README includes: Setup instructions (Docker + manual)
README includes: Tech stack decisions and tradeoffs
README includes: API documentation overview
README includes: Architecture diagram or description
README links to ADRs for detailed decisions

PostgreSQL is healthy and migrations have run
Backend responds on localhost:3000/health
